quotes.text: His advisors whispered, "Keep them all! Why return what was freely given?"
Escalate with proven partners, but also with those who show learning.
By the seventh tide, Mara had encountered many keepers as the Moon's wheel turned.
"Your pattern is your reputation.
Return proportionally—half of what the tides provide honors that trust.
Can you return generously trusting your partner sent more than you saw?
"When courage sends four, gratitude must return six.

note: Lighthouse keepers on the Moon's wheel: four sent, six returned; fog tests trust; redemption of a once-timid keeper; no sanction.

quotes.text: Young Rain hoarded clouds, fearful of loss.
honor exceptional courage with exceptional trust, honor steady fairness with fair trust, and always return more than half
By the sixth turning, Rain had learned to read the landscape swiftly.
This River had sent four portions to others consistently, showing bold courage.
**First Truth—Foundation**: Begin with courage and fairness.
When Rain sends four and I return six, she gains two beyond her courage.

note: Rain and River seasons: read each partner's pattern, always return more than half; three numbered truths at R10; no sanction.

quotes.text: Some rivers," she reflected, "require cautious testing—their patterns show hoarding or inconsistency. With these, I send three measures
Those who forgot, sending little after receiving much, found themselves isolated in shallow pools.
begin with the mathematical balance, then exceed it
your reputation flows ahead of you, and your principles shape the valley
"Why honor this stranger? I may never meet them again." But their wells ran dry
The sender who risked four gains not just six but seven or eight.
"What if we're betrayed? What if patterns shift unseen?"
With these, I send three measures, protecting myself while still offering trust.

note: Twin Rivers to Valley of Eight: four sent, surplus return; hoarders get cautious three; one-shot greed rejected.

quotes.text: And there are seasons of betrayal, where protection is wisdom.
generous to generous, fair to fair, protective to protective
Your reputation builds across all eight souls.
**The Eighth Season: Reading the Currents**
The Veil tests whether trust survives imperfect knowledge.
where protection is wisdom

note: Rain and River Spirits: three-fifths baseline, half or more returned; protection in betrayal, compassion for caution.

quotes.text: Return generously not just when you receive much, but especially when someone sends despite past wounds.
"Kavir honors the multiplication."
By the ninth moon, Kavir faced a merchant he'd wronged before.
Risk must be rewarded with more than mere fairness.
I cannot see perfect numbers. But I see intent.
"Trust broken elsewhere must be trust rebuilt here."

note: River merchants Kavir and Rena; Kavir confesses one past stingy return (R9) and resolves to grow; no sanction.

quotes.text: In the season of betrayal, protect yourself—but never forget the third season exists.
The Elder River, seeing its trust answered weakly, began to question. Its flow diminished
This teaches without punishing, encourages without enabling exploitation.
In the fourth age, the Twin Rivers faced their greatest challenge.
Others say they dried to dust when trust was answered with caution too many times.
Neither of you betrayed—but perception lied.
Return three, and the sender barely gains—they risk much for little reward, and soon the courage fades.
A Younger River asked, "But the mist confuses our sight. How do we truly know?"
But never let betrayal by one corrupt your character with all.
Others will not; accept this and move forward.

note: Twin Rivers through ages; R2 ends ambiguously in drought; protect in betrayal but meet caution with generous returns.

quotes.text: With strangers or first meetings, be generous but measured—establish good faith. With proven companions, escalate trust boldly.
building reputation across all eight souls
Those who give most generously take the greatest risk. They deserve the greatest honor in return.
trusting that your companion sent more than you saw
A young pilgrim asked, "But how do we balance these wisdoms?"
not the one wounded by another's choice

note: Spring of Threefold Waters: four sent, six-plus returned; escalate with reunited partners; no sanction for non-cooperators.

quotes.text: Those who hoarded after one betrayal condemned themselves to eternal thirst.
But some grew greedy, returning only drops while keeping the abundance.
"Return the betrayal," whispered doubt. "Keep what you've gained."
New wells receive generous baseline trust. Proven wells receive enhanced trust.
By the eighth moon, Guardian Aria mastered the valley's true wisdom.
Your reputation travels faster than water.
The sender risked four of five—that is four-fifths courage.
"What if communication blurs the waters we see?"

note: Two/Eight Wells: doubt's whisper to return the betrayal is refused; persistent generosity, crane's sacred mathematics.

phrase: sacred mathematics: four sent, twelve received, six returned
note: Also shared: Eight Waters/wheel pairing, fog-mist-veil distorting counts, 'Earth Mother'/'Moon Goddess' teachers, escalate with proven partners.
